cohort: Two thousand four hundred seventy-eight pregnant women were enrolled in Kuwait, with 2254 followed to delivery, and their children are being followed up.
finding: Frequencies of stillbirth, preterm birth, and small for gestational age were comparable to other developed countries, but macrosomia (6.1%) and large for gestational age (23.0%) were higher than expected and positively associated with pre-pregnancy maternal overweight/obesity.
